sources.authors: R. Brunetti, K. Fredenhagen and M. Kohler
sources.title: The microlocal spectrum condition and Wick polynomials of free fields on curved spacetimes
sources.use: existence and locality of quadratic Wick polynomials as operator-valued distributions in quasi-free Hadamard representations; no interacting or detector theorem is imported

sources.title: Essential self-adjointness of Wick squares in quasi-free Hadamard representations on curved spacetimes
sources.use: scope control: derivative quadratic Wick polynomials reduce to a one-particle compression problem; the present result does not claim the two charged branches are separately essentially self-adjoint

self_contained_step: For any closed densely defined K, the block [[0,K*],[K,0]] is proved self-adjoint here from its explicit plus/minus-i resolvents. This is not imported from either paper.
